rows.name: alias
rows.source:
#define CLASS Test
#xtranslate JOIN <!a!> <b> => <a>_<b>
? JOIN CLASS New

rows.name: numeric
rows.source:
#define VALUE 7
#xtranslate JOIN <!a!> <b> => <a>_<b>
? JOIN Test New + VALUE

rows.name: call_result
rows.source:
#define CLASS Test
#xtranslate ID(<x>) => <x>
#xtranslate JOIN <!a!> <b> => <a>_<b>
? ID(JOIN CLASS New)

rows.name: generated
rows.source:
#define CLASS Test
#xcommand FIRST => ? JOIN CLASS New
#xtranslate JOIN <!a!> <b> => <a>_<b>
FIRST

rows.name: fixed_alias
rows.source:
#define CLASS Test
#xtranslate JOIN Test New => DONE
? JOIN CLASS New

rows.name: fixed_numeric
rows.source:
#define VALUE 7
#xtranslate WORD TOKEN => DONE
? WORD TOKEN + VALUE
